backend/main.mo: Main canister actor handling access control, user profiles, blob storage integration, and admin‑restricted file reference management.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module copying blogViewCounts into a new OrderedMap structure without altering values.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of numerous frontend components and pages for reference.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point loading the React app root and main script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main application component handling routing, authentication state, language context, and conditional rendering of pages.
frontend/src/components/BlogPostModal.ts: Modal for creating or editing blog posts with image upload validation and Amsterdam timezone scheduling helpers.
frontend/src/components/BlogSection.tsx: Homepage blog/Instagram section with tab switching, video auto‑play logic, localized dates, and blog view count display.
frontend/src/components/BlogViewModal.ts: Modal displaying full blog post details, formatting content, dates, stats, and rendering images, tags, and metadata.
frontend/src/components/ContactSection.t: Contact section with info and a form that submits contact submissions via a mutation and resets on success.
frontend/src/components/CustomStoryImage: Empty placeholder file with no implemented component.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer showing brand info, navigation links, and social icons with language support.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Header with logo loading, navigation links, travel tools dropdown, and authentication-aware admin link handling.
frontend/src/components/HeroImageUploade: Uploader for replacing the hero image with validation, preview, upload handling, and automatic refresh.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Renders a responsive hero section with periodic hero image refresh and admin upload controls, displaying tools alongside the image.
frontend/src/components/InstagramFeedMan: Provides an interface to create, edit, preview, upload, and delete Instagram feed items with validation and media handling.
frontend/src/components/LanguageSelector: Displays a dropdown language picker with flag icons, updating app language via context.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Shows a login/logout button using Internet Identity, handling auth state and query cache clearing.
frontend/src/components/LogoUploader.tsx: Allows admins to upload and replace the site logo with validation, preview, and status feedback.
frontend/src/components/PackingListManag: Provides UI for managing default packing list categories and items, supporting editing, ordering, and subcategories.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal for creating a user profile with validation, language selection, and saving via backend mutation.
frontend/src/components/UserManagement.t: React component for listing users, displaying roles, and confirming role changes using backend queries and identity context.
frontend/src/contexts/LanguageContext.ts: Provides a language context with translation lookup, localStorage persistence, and a provider for multi-language UI support.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous actor, refreshing dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Manages Internet Identity authentication, persists identity, and exposes login, logout, and status through React context.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for admin checks, user profiles, and fetching or mutating user-related backend data via the actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Global Tailwind-based stylesheet defining color variables, typography, utilities, and visual effects for the UI.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point initializing React, Internet Identity provider, React Query client, and global styles.
frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.tsx: Admin interface handling blog posts, contacts, media, tools, shop items, and settings with multiple tabs and modal management.
frontend/src/pages/BlogDetailPage.tsx: Displays a single blog post, increments view count, formats markdown images, and provides sharing and navigation options.
frontend/src/pages/BlogPage.tsx: Shows paginated list of published blogs with view counts, language-aware dates, and navigation controls.
frontend/src/pages/GeographyQuiz.tsx: Implements a geography quiz with flag and capital questions, large country dataset, scoring, and Instagram story export.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Homepage composing hero, blog, shop, and contact sections.
frontend/src/pages/PackingList.tsx: Interactive packing list with categories, item selection, custom items, filtering, and sharing/ download features.
frontend/src/pages/ShopPage.tsx: Displays published shop products with search, sorting, image carousel, and a modal for product details and affiliate links.
frontend/src/pages/TrainVsFlightPrices.t: Compares mock flight and train options, showing price, duration, and savings between travel modes.
frontend/src/pages/TravelStyleQuiz.tsx: Runs a quiz to determine a user's travel archetype and supports generating shareable Instagram story results.
frontend/src/pages/TripRandomizer.tsx: Randomly generates a trip by pairing mock flights and hotels, showing destination details, prices, and highlights.
frontend/src/utils/instagramStoryGenerat: Creates Instagram Story images using canvas with optional custom backgrounds, branding, and text layout.
frontend/src/utils/toast.ts: Implements a toast notification manager with subscription, timed removal, and helper for showing messages.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with dark mode, content paths, custom OKLCH color system, animations, container settings, and typography/container-queries/animate plugins.
project_state.json: Defines project metadata, header icon adjustments, and blog view‑count feature requests including initial random counts and persistent increments.
